status_definitions.live_verified: Existing repository evidence records an executed Hy3 provider workflow.
status_definitions.offline_verified: A deterministic local workflow was executed without a provider request.
status_definitions.documented_not_executed: Instructions exist, but this variant was not executed for this delivery.
status_definitions.configuration_only: Evidence establishes configuration or local structure, not a completed provider task.
status_definitions.not_applicable: The field or verification mode does not apply.
status_definitions.unknown: The repository evidence does not support a value.

hard_requirements: At least five tool guides, each covering configuration, first conversation, and a real task.
Each guide includes installation and version requirements.
Each guide documents Base URL, model, authentication, and protocol selection.
Each guide includes an end-to-end screenshot or GIF and common configuration notes.
Part A is delivered under docs/integrations/ with an index and evidence media.
Part B is an independent open-source repository with a README and a demo using at least one Hy3 core capability.
The Part B demo video or GIF does not exceed 60 seconds.

limitations: The retained CLI Live report was captured with tool version 1.1.0 and was not re-executed or rewritten for release 1.2.0.

Local schema and citation checks do not prove semantic correctness.
Evidence hashes prove byte identity and change detection, not independent provider-call authenticity.
Automated textual scanning does not inspect PNG pixels, PNG ancillary chunks, MP4 frames, or MP4 container metadata.
The npm package excludes both repository-only MP4 files and is not the complete repository evidence archive.
Remote-link availability is outside deterministic CI.
